Your child used to be the funny one. The one telling you about the dragon at recess. Now they stay quiet in class, never raise a hand, and say "it's fine" when you ask.

Fear rarely shows up loudly. Like a skipped brushing on a rushed morning, it starts small, harmless at first, and then it grows. Every time they stay quiet, the fear gets a little stronger.

"The fear of man bringeth a snare: but whoso putteth his trust in the Lord shall be safe." Proverbs 29:25

BravePath Kids is a Christ-centered 21-day journey for childhood anxiety, made for parents and kids to do together:
✨ Simple anxiety skills
📖 Scripture they can hold onto
🙏 Prayer
❤️ Love in action
Ages 4-6, 7-9 and 10-12.

You don't have to wait for your quiet one to find their voice alone. Walk the path with them, one small step a day.
